description: This file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardNightMode' that manages night mode functionality for a keyboard app, including observing night mode state changes, updating UI watermarks, and creating overlay data for night mode.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardNightMode
classes.description: An abstract class that manages night mode state, UI watermark updates, and overlay creation for a keyboard application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes night mode observers and sets up UI updates based on night mode state.

methods.name: generateWatermark
methods.description: Generates a list of watermark drawables, adding a night mode watermark if night mode is active.

methods.name: createOverlayDataCreator
methods.description: Creates and returns an overlay data creator configured for night mode appearance.
